failures.evidence: Against the real cmd/dispatch binary built at 2d30e173f5ae on PostgreSQL 17.11, signed in as alice with the dashboard origin: CORE's default was alice@example.com; `PUT /api/v1/projects/CORE/default-assignee` with body `{}` -> `200 {"project":"CORE","assignee":null}` and the stored default was cleared.
